name: Ziba
title: Saul's Servant Who Betrayed Mephibosheth
summary: Ziba was a servant in Saul's household who was appointed by King David to manage Mephibosheth's estates. He is best known for slandering his master Mephibosheth before David during Absalom's rebellion, attempting thereby to seize Mephibosheth's property through deceit.

keyEvents.title: David Seeks Saul's Descendants
keyEvents.description: David asked if anyone remained from the house of Saul whom he could show kindness to for Jonathan's sake. Ziba, a servant in Saul's house, was brought and told David about Mephibosheth, Jonathan's son.

keyEvents.title: Ziba Appointed to Manage Mephibosheth's Land
keyEvents.description: David returned all of Saul's land to Mephibosheth and commanded Ziba, his sons and servants, to farm the land for Mephibosheth. Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

keyEvents.title: Ziba Meets David During Flight from Absalom
keyEvents.description: When David fled from Jerusalem during Absalom's rebellion, Ziba met him with donkeys, bread, raisin cakes, and wine. He claimed that Mephibosheth had stayed behind in Jerusalem to regain Saul's kingdom.

keyEvents.title: David Gives Mephibosheth's Property to Ziba
keyEvents.description: Based on Ziba's false accusations against Mephibosheth, David gave all of Mephibosheth's property to Ziba. Ziba bowed and thanked the king.

keyEvents.title: Mephibosheth Explains Himself to David
keyEvents.description: When David returned to Jerusalem after Absalom's defeat, Mephibosheth explained that Ziba had deceived him and not prepared the donkey so he could follow the king. Mephibosheth claimed that Ziba had slandered him.

keyEvents.title: David Divides the Property Between Ziba and Mephibosheth
keyEvents.description: David decided that Mephibosheth and Ziba should share the land between them. Mephibosheth replied that Ziba could take everything, since the king had returned safely.
